title: A local-first content workflow
excerpt: Why keeping structured content beside the site makes iteration easier to understand and safer to review.
body:
## Content you can inspect

The source of truth is a small set of JSON files in Git. Pages CMS edits them, Astro renders them, and normal code review shows exactly what changed.

## One feedback loop

Run the editor and preview together. A save in the CMS refreshes the local site without a database export or synchronization job.
